ops.text: 00:52 PDT 2026-10-13, after deploying 12.93.3 (PR #360, which removes the per-worker warm scheduler): the growth reappeared within two minutes on a fresh worker. Worker 61683 (root monorepo/sole, shard 7, started 00:50:05) reached RSS 14.1 GiB with physical footprint 1.67 GiB and read 3.9 GiB/min from disk, against 0.64 GiB/min for the snapshot owner. So it is independent of transcript warming. Eight lsof samples of 61683 show it holding ~/.claude/state/hooks/sessions/900424b6-7393-480c-a26a-f1bd21da6e57/rotation_state.json.lock and reading ~/.claude/teams/session-67c0e5da/config.json (1.26 MB). That lock belongs to the lane-rotation hooks, the same note_flushed_lanes / escalate_unrotated_lanes / ask_lanes_to_rotate that were abandoned in the 25 s Stop dispatch. Session 900424b6 is also the one with a 476 MB captain-hook session log. Still not established: the large file read line by line with json.loads.
